payload.objective: Complete the general resource installation reliability contract: content-addressed immutable artifacts, capacity-aware candidate installation, durable phase recovery, and repair.
boundaries: Local code, focused tests, builds, device installation, and local phase commits only. Do not push or release.
For each phase, validation is limited to one concrete target effect plus one final true-device crash check; no broad suites.
Do not disable concurrency, add resource/device special cases, or restore UI-owned installation state.

payload.title: close immutable artifact integrity
payload.objective: Key bundled artifacts by package identity, version, and manifest digest; verify declared size and SHA-256 before atomic publication; persist a validation receipt and prevent mutation after publication.
acceptance: A deliberately truncated staged file is rejected before publication while a valid artifact publishes with a matching receipt.
invariants: Do not hash the complete published pack on every ordinary app launch.
payload.nextAction: Inspect the build-time asset manifest and current publication consumer path.

payload.title: install through a capacity-aware candidate
payload.objective: Preflight required working space, install into an owned candidate, validate it, and atomically activate without losing the last known-good install.
acceptance: Insufficient space is rejected before mutation; a validated candidate becomes formal while a failed candidate preserves the prior install.
invariants: Avoid retaining duplicate full installations after commit.

payload.title: persist and recover transaction phases
payload.objective: Persist prepare, install, verify, commit, and rollback facts and recover each interrupted boundary deterministically at startup.
acceptance: One injected interrupted phase recovers to a valid prior or newly committed installation without ambiguous cleanup.
invariants: The resource state owner, not the View layer, owns durable transaction truth.

payload.title: formalize repair and precise retry
payload.objective: Expose repair for installed-but-invalid resources and preserve root failure versus dependency blocking with failed-item-only retry.
acceptance: An invalid installed resource exposes repair, and repair mutates only its declared write scopes.
invariants: Do not add agent-specific or device-specific recovery behavior.

payload.summary: The focused integrity test rejected a truncated staged file before receipt creation and accepted a valid receipt; assembleDebug succeeded; Meizu 18 cold start reached MainActivity with process 537 alive and no AndroidRuntime or ActivityManager error.

payload.summary: Use per-resource candidate bind mounts instead of a whole-environment View transaction.
payload.reason: A whole-environment View permits only one active transaction per environment and would reject otherwise non-conflicting resource installs; direct directory renames also break tools that embed stable absolute install paths.
payload.impact: Each run binds an owned candidate install root and candidate command directory onto stable guest paths; writeScopes continue to control concurrency and the validated root is atomically activated.

payload.name: capacity-aware independent candidates preserve last-known-good installs
payload.summary: The focused candidate test rejected insufficient capacity before pending-directory creation, kept two non-conflicting resources in independent candidates, committed one without changing the other, and rolled the other back to its prior install. assembleDebug succeeded; Meizu 18 cold start reached MainActivity with process 3282 alive and no AndroidRuntime or ActivityManager error.

payload.name: interrupted root activation restores the durable prior state
payload.summary: The focused recovery test injected process death after candidate root activation but before commit completion; a fresh coordinator restored the prior install root and command, removed owned pending residue, and reported RESTORED. assembleDebug succeeded; Meizu 18 cold start reached MainActivity with process 4590 alive and no AndroidRuntime or ActivityManager error.
